title: Compute on-time and stacked on-time per country (DART-v1 defs)
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.country_code,
    -- validity flag per DART-v1
    ( (o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 IS NULL OR o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 IS NOT NULL)
      AND o.order_status = "completed" AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE ) AS valid,
    (d.stacked_deliveries > 0) AS is_stacked,
    ABS(o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 - o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60) <= 10 AS on_time
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.curated_data_shared.orders` o
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(deliveries) d ON d.is_primary
  WHERE o.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND o.order_status = "completed"
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  ROUND(100 * COUNTIF(valid AND on_time) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(valid),0), 2) AS ontime_pct,
  ROUND(100 * COUNTIF(valid AND is_stacked AND on_time) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(valid AND is_stacked),0), 2) AS stacked_ontime_pct
FROM base
GROUP BY country_code
HAVING COUNTIF(valid) >= 10000
ORDER BY country_code

title: Final ranking of countries by stacking and acceptance time
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.region,
    o.country_code,
    d.stacked_deliveries AS stk,
    d.timings.rider_reaction_time AS accept_sec
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.curated_data_shared.orders` o
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(deliveries) d ON d.is_primary
  WHERE o.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND o.order_status = "completed"
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    ANY_VALUE(region) AS region,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(100*COUNTIF(stk >= 1)/COUNT(*), 2) AS stacking_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(accept_sec), 1) AS accept_sec
  FROM base
  GROUP BY country_code
  HAVING orders >= 10000
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY stacking_pct DESC) AS rk_stack,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY accept_sec ASC)    AS rk_accept
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  country_code, region, orders, stacking_pct, accept_sec,
  rk_stack, rk_accept,
  (rk_stack + rk_accept) AS combined_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY combined_score ASC

sql:
DECLARE start_dt, end_dt DATE;
SET start_dt = '2026-06-11';
SET end_dt   = '2026-07-04';

WITH int_tapi_logs AS (
  SELECT
    t.country_code, t.order_id, t.created_at,
    CASE
      WHEN eta_format_config_allocation_id LIKE '%Control%'    THEN 'Control'
      WHEN eta_format_config_allocation_id LIKE '%Treatment1%' THEN 'Treatment_1'
      WHEN eta_format_config_allocation_id LIKE '%Treatment2%' THEN 'Treatment_2'
    END AS variant,
    SAFE_CAST(t.customer_prediction_lower_bound_minutes  AS FLOAT64) AS c_lb_min,
    SAFE_CAST(t.customer_prediction_median_bound_minutes AS FLOAT64) AS c_median_min
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.tracking_api_logs` t, UNNEST(deliveries) AS d
  WHERE t.created_date BETWEEN start_dt AND end_dt
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%Go-http-client%'
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%Ktor%'
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%Vert.x-WebClient%'
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%gfs-order-processing%'
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%PostmanRuntime%'
    AND metadata.user_agent NOT LIKE '%Faraday%'
    AND (eta_format_config_allocation_id LIKE '%Control%' OR eta_format_config_allocation_id LIKE '%Treatment%')
    AND t.country_code IN ('ae','bh','eg','iq','jo','kw','om','qa')
    AND (t.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND t.customer_id != '')
    AND TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(TIMESTAMP(model_prediction_median_bound_timestamp), MINUTE) != '1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC'
    AND JSON_EXTRACT(d, '$.primary_delivery') = 'true'
),
single_variant AS (
  SELECT country_code, order_id FROM int_tapi_logs
  GROUP BY country_code, order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant) = 1
),
tapi AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM int_tapi_logs a JOIN single_variant b USING (country_code, order_id)
),
order_rider AS (
  SELECT
    a.country_code, a.global_order_id AS order_id,
    TIMESTAMP(r.rider_accepted_at)      AS rider_accepted_at,
    TIMESTAMP(r.rider_picked_up_at)     AS rider_picked_up_at,
    TIMESTAMP(r.rider_near_customer_at) AS rider_near_customer_at,
    TIMESTAMP(r.rider_dropped_off_at)   AS rider_dropped_off_at
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` a, UNNEST(deliveries) r
  WHERE a.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(start_dt, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND end_dt
    AND a.country_code IN ('ae','bh','eg','iq','jo','kw','om','qa')
    AND r.is_primary
),
snap_staged AS (
  SELECT
    t.country_code, t.order_id, t.variant, t.created_at,
    o.rider_near_customer_at, o.rider_dropped_off_at,
    CASE
      WHEN o.rider_accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at >= o.rider_accepted_at
           AND (t.created_at < COALESCE(o.rider_picked_up_at, o.rider_near_customer_at, o.rider_dropped_off_at)
                OR COALESCE(o.rider_picked_up_at, o.rider_near_customer_at, o.rider_dropped_off_at) IS NULL)
        THEN '2.Between Rider Accepted and Pickup'
      WHEN o.rider_picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at >= o.rider_picked_up_at
           AND (t.created_at < COALESCE(o.rider_near_customer_at, o.rider_dropped_off_at)
                OR COALESCE(o.rider_near_customer_at, o.rider_dropped_off_at) IS NULL)
        THEN '3.Between Pickup and Near DO'
    END AS stage
  FROM tapi t
  LEFT JOIN order_rider o USING (country_code, order_id)
  WHERE (t.c_lb_min < 5 OR t.c_median_min < 5)
),
order_stage AS (   -- first sub-5 request per order x stage; durations FROM that request
  SELECT
    country_code, order_id, variant, stage, created_at,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(rider_near_customer_at, created_at, SECOND)/60 AS mins_to_near_do,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(rider_dropped_off_at,   created_at, SECOND)/60 AS mins_to_delivered
  FROM snap_staged
  WHERE stage IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code, order_id, stage ORDER BY created_at) = 1
)
SELECT
  stage,
  variant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)                                        AS orders_sub5,
  ROUND(AVG(mins_to_near_do), 2)                                  AS avg_near_do,
  ROUND(APPROX_QUANTILES(mins_to_near_do, 100)[OFFSET(50)], 2)    AS p50_near_do,
  ROUND(AVG(mins_to_delivered), 2)                                AS avg_delivered,
  ROUND(APPROX_QUANTILES(mins_to_delivered, 100)[OFFSET(50)], 2)  AS p50_delivered,
  -- NEW: orders whose sub-5 request still had >5 min to near-dropoff AND >9 min to delivery
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(mins_to_near_do > 5 AND mins_to_delivered > 9, order_id, NULL)) AS orders_neardo_gt5_delivered_gt9,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COUNT(DISTINCT IF(mins_to_near_do > 5 AND mins_to_delivered > 9, order_id, NULL)),
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id))*100, 2)                         AS pct_neardo_gt5_delivered_gt9
FROM order_stage
WHERE variant IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY stage, variant
ORDER BY stage, variant

  SELECT

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL: Country-level comparison — Control vs Treatment1 vs Treatment2
-- Metrics: % orders (traffic split), delay fail rate, HCSR, jump rate
--
-- Requires two upstream fixes in filtered_TAPI_logs:
--   1) allocation_id label:
--        REGEXP_EXTRACT(t.eta_format_config_allocation_id,
--                       r':(Control|Treatment\d+)$') AS model_version
--   2) allocation_id IN (...) filter must list all three arms, all under
--      the `tapi-config-variant` prefix:
--        'logistics-otx:tapi-config-variant:..._538:Control',
--        'logistics-otx:tapi-config-variant:..._538:Treatment1',
--        'logistics-otx:tapi-config-variant:..._538:Treatment2'
--
-- Replace the three `SELECT * FROM union_agg ... UNION ALL ...` blocks
-- with everything below. (Keep all CTEs through `union_agg` unchanged.)
-- =====================================================================

, country_level AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    entity,
    model_version,                                   -- 'Control' / 'Treatment1' / 'Treatment2'
    SUM(num_orders)                AS num_orders,
    SUM(delay_fail_rate_numerator) AS delay_fail_num,
    SUM(hcsr_numerator)            AS hcsr_num,
    SUM(jump_rate)                 AS jump_num
  FROM union_agg
  GROUP BY region, entity, model_version
),

-- Per-country rows AND an all-countries total (numerators summed per arm,
-- then divided -> a properly order-weighted total, not an average of rates)
arm_agg AS (
  SELECT
    entity,                                   -- NULL = total across all countries
    model_version,
    SUM(num_orders)     AS num_orders,
    SUM(delay_fail_num) AS delay_fail_num,
    SUM(hcsr_num)       AS hcsr_num,
    SUM(jump_num)       AS jump_num
  FROM country_level
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((entity, model_version), (model_version))
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(entity, 'TOTAL') AS entity,

  -- % orders (traffic split across the three arms; sums to ~100%)
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Control',    num_orders, NULL)), SUM(num_orders)) * 100, 1) AS pct_orders_control,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment1', num_orders, NULL)), SUM(num_orders)) * 100, 1) AS pct_orders_t1,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment2', num_orders, NULL)), SUM(num_orders)) * 100, 1) AS pct_orders_t2,

  -- Delay fail rate
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Control',    SAFE_DIVIDE(delay_fail_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS delay_fail_control,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment1', SAFE_DIVIDE(delay_fail_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS delay_fail_t1,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment2', SAFE_DIVIDE(delay_fail_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS delay_fail_t2,

  -- HC session rate (HCSR)
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Control',    SAFE_DIVIDE(hcsr_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS hcsr_control,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment1', SAFE_DIVIDE(hcsr_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS hcsr_t1,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment2', SAFE_DIVIDE(hcsr_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS hcsr_t2,

  -- Jump rate
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Control',    SAFE_DIVIDE(jump_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS jump_rate_control,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment1', SAFE_DIVIDE(jump_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS jump_rate_t1,
  ROUND(MAX(IF(model_version = 'Treatment2', SAFE_DIVIDE(jump_num, num_orders), NULL)) * 100, 2) AS jump_rate_t2

FROM arm_agg
GROUP BY entity
ORDER BY (entity IS NULL), entity;   -- TOTAL row last

sql:
import json
with open('/tmp/all_markets.json') as f:
    data = json.loads(f.read())
print(f"Total brand×country×week rows: {len(data)}")

from collections import defaultdict
m = defaultdict(dict)
for r in data:
    m[(r['brand'], r['country_code'])][r['report_week']] = r

# Determine current and prior week labels
weeks = sorted({r['report_week'] for r in data})
w_curr = weeks[-1]
w_prev = weeks[0]

thresholds = {
    'PET':                ('+', 0.3),  # worse when up
    'pct_on_time':        ('-', 1.0),  # worse when down
    'pct_stacked_on_time':('-', 1.5),
    'pct_dt45_qc':        ('+', 1.0),
}

rows = []
for (brand, cc), wks in m.items():
    c, p = wks.get(w_curr), wks.get(w_prev)
    if not c or not p: continue
    vol = int(c['volume'])
    if vol < 50000:  # ignore micro markets
        continue
    qc_curr = int(c.get('qc_orders') or 0)
    deltas = {}
    severity_pp = 0  # max pp/threshold ratio in WORSE direction
    worse_kpis = []
    for kpi, (dir, thr) in thresholds.items():
        cv, pv = c.get(kpi), p.get(kpi)
        if cv is None or pv is None: continue
        if kpi == 'pct_dt45_qc' and qc_curr < 500: continue  # ignore noisy QC
        d = float(cv) - float(pv)
        is_worse = (d > 0) if dir == '+' else (d < 0)
        deltas[kpi] = (d, is_worse, abs(d)/thr if is_worse else 0)
        if is_worse and abs(d) >= thr:
            worse_kpis.append(kpi)
            severity_pp = max(severity_pp, abs(d)/thr)
    rows.append({
        'brand': brand, 'cc': cc, 'vol': vol,
        'severity': severity_pp,
        'deltas': deltas,
        'worse_kpis': worse_kpis,
        'curr': c, 'prev': p
    })

# Sort by severity (threshold multiples) desc
rows.sort(key=lambda x: -x['severity'])

# Print top 15 (we'll show user top 10 but include a couple more for context)
print(f"\nW22 ({w_curr}) vs W21 ({w_prev}) — top markets ranked by max worsening (in multiples of significance threshold)\n")
print(f"{'#':>2}  {'Brand':<14} {'CC':<6} {'Vol':>9}  {'sev':>5}  {'PET Δ':>8}  {'OnT Δ':>8}  {'StkOnT Δ':>10}  {'DT45 QC Δ':>10}")
print("-"*100)
def f(v, thr, dir):
    if v is None: return f"{'-':>8}"
    d, is_worse, _ = v
    return f"{d:+.2f}{'⚠' if is_worse and abs(d)>=thr else ''}"
for i, r in enumerate(rows[:15], 1):
    d = r['deltas']
    pet = f(d.get('PET'), 0.3, '+')
    ot  = f(d.get('pct_on_time'), 1.0, '-')
    sot = f(d.get('pct_stacked_on_time'), 1.5, '-')
    qc  = f(d.get('pct_dt45_qc'), 1.0, '+')
    print(f"{i:>2}  {r['brand']:<14} {r['cc']:<6} {r['vol']:>9,}  {r['severity']:>5.1f}x  {pet:>8}  {ot:>8}  {sot:>10}  {qc:>10}")

print("\n(severity = max worsening Δ ÷ that KPI's threshold; ⚠ marks crossings)")

sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  CASE
  WHEN o.country_code IN ( 'at', 'cz', 'de2', 'dk', 'fi', 'hu', 'no', 'se', 'sk') OR o.region IN( 'Asia' ) OR  o.country_code IN ( 't3', 't5') THEN 'Pandora'
  WHEN o.country_code IN ( 'gr', 'cy') THEN 'Efood'
  WHEN o.country_code IN( 'ae', 'bh', 'eg', 'iq', 'jo', 'kw', 'om', 'qa' ) THEN 'Talabat'
  WHEN o.country_code IN( 'sa' ) THEN 'Hungerstation'
  WHEN o.region IN( 'Americas' ) THEN 'Pedidosya'
  WHEN o.country_code IN ( 'kr2') THEN 'Woowa'
  WHEN o.country_code LIKE '%gv-%' THEN 'Glovo'
  END AS brands
, o.country_code
, FORMAT_DATE('%GW%V', COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone)) ) AS report_week
, CASE
  WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type = 'restaurants' THEN 'restaurants'
  WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type = 'darkstores' THEN 'darkstores'
  WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type IN ( "courier_business", "courier") THEN 'other'
  ELSE 'Grocery multicategory'
  END AS wider_vertical_type_v2
, IF( order_status = 'completed', o.order_id, NULL ) AS orders_completed
, IF ( ( o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 IS NULL OR o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 IS NOT NULL ) AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE AND ABS( o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 - o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 ) <= 10, o.order_id, NULL )  AS order_on_time
, IF( (o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 IS NULL OR o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 IS NOT NULL) AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE, o.order_id, NULL ) AS order_late
, IF( ( o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 IS NULL OR o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 IS NOT NULL ) AND d.stacked_deliveries > 0 AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE AND ABS( o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 - o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 ) <= 10, o.order_id, NULL )  AS stacked_order_on_time
, IF( (o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 IS NULL OR o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 IS NOT NULL) AND d.stacked_deliveries > 0 AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE, o.order_id, NULL ) AS stacked_order_late
, IF( o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE, o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60, NULL ) AS DT
, IF( o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE AND o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 > 45, o.order_id,  NULL ) AS DT_45_numerator
, IF( o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE, o.order_id , NULL ) AS DT_45_denominator
, estimated_prep_time/60  AS EPT
, o.timings.avoidable_wait_time/60  AS AWT
, o.timings.at_vendor_time/60 AS AVT
, TIMESTAMP_DIFF(d.rider_picked_up_at, o.created_at, MINUTE) AS created_to_PU
FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` o
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(deliveries) d ON is_primary
WHERE
 o.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 35 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
AND COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone)) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 35 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE
AND o.order_status = 'completed'
AND o.country_code != 'kr2'
),
with_pet AS (
SELECT *,
 CASE
 WHEN brands = 'Hungerstation' THEN 0.7 * created_to_PU + 0.3 * AWT + 0.0 * (AVT - AWT)
 WHEN brands = 'Talabat' THEN 0.5 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT + 0.1 * (AVT - AWT)
 WHEN brands = 'Glovo' THEN 0.2 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT + 0.4 * (AVT - AWT)
 WHEN brands = 'Pandora' THEN 0.25 * created_to_PU + 0.45 * AWT + 0.3 * (AVT - AWT)
 WHEN brands = 'Pedidosya' THEN 0.25 * created_to_PU + 0.5 * AWT + 0.25 * (AVT - AWT)
 WHEN brands = 'Efood' THEN 0.2 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT + 0.4 * (AVT - AWT)
 ELSE NULL
 END AS PET
FROM base
)
SELECT
  brands,
  country_code,
  report_week,
  COUNT(orders_completed) AS volume,
  ROUND(AVG(PET), 2) AS PET,
  ROUND(100 * COUNT(order_on_time) / NULLIF(COUNT(order_late),0), 2) AS pct_on_time,
  ROUND(100 * COUNT(stacked_order_on_time) / NULLIF(COUNT(stacked_order_late),0), 2) AS pct_stacked_on_time,
  ROUND(100 * COUNTIF(wider_vertical_type_v2 = 'darkstores' AND DT > 45) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(wider_vertical_type_v2 = 'darkstores' AND DT IS NOT NULL),0), 2) AS dt45_qc,
  COUNTIF(wider_vertical_type_v2 = 'darkstores' AND DT IS NOT NULL) AS qc_volume
FROM with_pet
WHERE brands IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY brands, country_code, report_week

title: Compute % orders with fixed EPT per period/geo/PDT bucket
sql:
WITH config_history AS (
  SELECT
    vendor_code,
    entity_id,
    pt.strategy,
    pt.updated_at
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl._vendors_tes_prep_time_config`,
    UNNEST(prep_time_config) pt
  WHERE pt.updated_at IS NOT NULL
    AND pt.updated_at <= TIMESTAMP("2026-05-25")
),
orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.vendor.vendor_code AS vendor_code,
    o.entity.id AS entity_id,
    o.created_at,
    CASE WHEN o.country_code = "ar" THEN "AR" ELSE "Rest of Americas" END AS geo,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE(o.created_date) BETWEEN "2026-04-30" AND "2026-05-03" THEN "P1"
      WHEN DATE(o.created_date) BETWEEN "2026-05-10" AND "2026-05-13" THEN "P2"
      WHEN DATE(o.created_date) BETWEEN "2026-05-18" AND "2026-05-24" THEN "P3"
    END AS period,
    AVG(IF(is_preorder IS FALSE, estimated_prep_time/60, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id) AS EPT,
    AVG(IF(is_preorder IS FALSE, o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id) AS PDT,
    AVG(IF(is_preorder IS FALSE, o.timings.order_delay/60, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id) AS OD
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` o
  WHERE DATE(o.created_date) BETWEEN "2026-04-30" AND "2026-05-24"
    AND o.region = "Americas"
    AND is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND order_status = "completed"
    AND LOWER(o.vendor.vertical_type) = "darkstores"
),
orders_dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, vendor_code, entity_id, created_at, geo, period, EPT, PDT, OD
  FROM orders
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
),
orders_with_strategy AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id, o.geo, o.period, o.EPT, o.PDT, o.OD,
    c.strategy
  FROM orders_dedup o
  LEFT JOIN config_history c
    ON c.vendor_code = o.vendor_code
    AND c.entity_id = o.entity_id
    AND c.updated_at <= o.created_at
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    period, geo,
    CASE WHEN PDT < EPT THEN "PDT < EPT" ELSE "PDT >= EPT" END AS pdt_bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN strategy IN ("OPS_TEMPORARY", "OPS_PERMANENT") THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_fixed_ept
  FROM orders_with_strategy
  WHERE PDT IS NOT NULL AND EPT IS NOT NULL AND OD IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  period, geo, pdt_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(is_fixed_ept) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_fixed_ept
FROM classified
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY period, geo, pdt_bucket

title: Execute DART Query 1+2 hybrid aggregated KPIs for past 2 weeks
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN o.country_code IN ("at","cz","de2","dk","fi","hu","no","se","sk") OR o.region IN ("Asia") OR o.country_code IN ("t3","t5") THEN "Pandora"
      WHEN o.country_code IN ("gr","cy") THEN "Efood"
      WHEN o.country_code IN ("ae","bh","eg","iq","jo","kw","om","qa") THEN "Talabat"
      WHEN o.country_code IN ("sa") THEN "Hungerstation"
      WHEN o.region IN ("Americas") THEN "Pedidosya"
      WHEN o.country_code IN ("kr2") THEN "Woowa"
      WHEN o.country_code LIKE "%gv-%" THEN "Glovo"
    END AS brand,
    o.country_code,
    FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone))) AS report_week,
    CASE
      WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type = "restaurants" THEN "restaurants"
      WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type = "darkstores" THEN "darkstores"
      WHEN o.vendor.vertical_type IN ("courier_business","courier") THEN "other"
      ELSE "Grocery multicategory"
    END AS wider_vertical_type_v2,
    o.order_id,
    o.timings.actual_delivery_time/60 AS DT_min,
    o.timings.promised_delivery_time/60 AS PDT_min,
    o.timings.avoidable_wait_time/60 AS AWT_min,
    o.timings.at_vendor_time/60 AS AVT_min,
    o.timings.at_vendor_time_cleaned/60 AS AAPT_min,
    o.estimated_prep_time/60 AS EPT_min,
    o.estimated_prep_buffer/60 AS EPB_min,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(d.rider_picked_up_at, o.created_at, MINUTE) AS created_to_PU,
    o.timings.rider_late/60 AS rider_late_min,
    o.timings.at_customer_time/60 AS at_customer_time_min,
    d.stacked_deliveries
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` o
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(deliveries) d ON is_primary
  WHERE o.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
    AND COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone))
        BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND o.order_status = "completed"
    AND o.country_code != "kr2"
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    brand,
    country_code,
    report_week,
    COUNT(*) AS volume,
    -- PET (brand-weighted formula, simplified to AVG components)
    ROUND(AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN brand = "Hungerstation" THEN 0.7 * created_to_PU + 0.3 * AWT_min + 0.0 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        WHEN brand = "Talabat"       THEN 0.5 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT_min + 0.1 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        WHEN brand = "Glovo"         THEN 0.2 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT_min + 0.4 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        WHEN brand = "Pandora"       THEN 0.25 * created_to_PU + 0.45 * AWT_min + 0.3 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        WHEN brand = "Pedidosya"     THEN 0.25 * created_to_PU + 0.5 * AWT_min + 0.25 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        WHEN brand = "Efood"         THEN 0.2 * created_to_PU + 0.4 * AWT_min + 0.4 * (AVT_min - AWT_min)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ), 2) AS PET,
    -- % on-time (±10 mins)
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(ABS(DT_min - PDT_min) <= 10) / NULLIF(COUNT(PDT_min), 0), 2) AS pct_on_time,
    -- % stacked on-time
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(stacked_deliveries > 0 AND ABS(DT_min - PDT_min) <= 10) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(stacked_deliveries > 0 AND PDT_min IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS pct_stacked_on_time,
    -- DT > 45 % for QC (grocery + darkstores)
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(wider_vertical_type_v2 IN ("darkstores","Grocery multicategory") AND DT_min > 45) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(wider_vertical_type_v2 IN ("darkstores","Grocery multicategory")), 0), 2) AS pct_dt45_qc,
    -- Diagnostics
    ROUND(AVG(created_to_PU), 2) AS TTP,
    ROUND(AVG(AWT_min), 2) AS AWT,
    ROUND(AVG(DT_min), 2) AS DT,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(stacked_deliveries > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_stacked,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(rider_late_min > 10) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(rider_late_min IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS rider_late_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(at_customer_time_min), 2) AS to_customer_time,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(EPB_min > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_with_buffer,
    ROUND(AVG(EPT_min), 2) AS EPT,
    ROUND(AVG(AAPT_min), 2) AS AAPT
  FROM base
  WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT *
FROM agg
WHERE report_week IN (
  FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)),
  FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
)
ORDER BY country_code, report_week

title: Cross-tab PDT bucket × order_type by vertical group
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN vendor.vertical_type = "restaurants"       THEN "1_restaurants"
      WHEN vendor.vertical_type = "darkstores"        THEN "2_darkstores"
      WHEN vendor.vertical_type IS NULL               THEN "_excluded"
      WHEN vendor.vertical_type IN ("courier","courier_business") THEN "_excluded"
      ELSE "3_other"
    END AS vertical_group,
    estimated_prep_time / 60.0 AS EPT,
    timings.promised_delivery_time / 60.0 AS PDT,
    timings.order_delay / 60.0 AS OD
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders`
  WHERE region = "Americas"
    AND is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND order_status = "completed"
    AND created_date BETWEEN "2026-04-26" AND "2026-05-25"
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    vertical_group,
    CASE
      WHEN PDT > EPT THEN "PDT > EPT"
      WHEN PDT < EPT THEN "PDT < EPT"
      ELSE "PDT = EPT"
    END AS pdt_bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN OD > 10  THEN "late"
      WHEN OD < -10 THEN "early"
      ELSE "on_time"
    END AS order_type
  FROM base
  WHERE EPT IS NOT NULL AND PDT IS NOT NULL AND vertical_group != "_excluded"
)
SELECT
  vertical_group,
  pdt_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY vertical_group) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_vertical,
  ROUND(COUNTIF(order_type="late")    / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS pct_late,
  ROUND(COUNTIF(order_type="early")   / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS pct_early,
  ROUND(COUNTIF(order_type="on_time") / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS pct_on_time
FROM flagged
GROUP BY vertical_group, pdt_bucket
ORDER BY vertical_group, pdt_bucket

title: Compute %PDT>EPT and order_type breakdown for Americas, last 30 days
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    platform_order_id AS order_id,
    estimated_prep_time / 60 AS EPT,
    o.timings.promised_delivery_time / 60 AS PDT,
    o.timings.order_delay / 60 AS OD
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` o
  WHERE region = "Americas"
    AND is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND order_status = "completed"
    AND created_date BETWEEN "2026-04-26" AND "2026-05-25"
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    EPT,
    PDT,
    OD,
    (PDT > EPT) AS pdt_gt_ept,
    CASE
      WHEN OD > 10  THEN "order_late"
      WHEN OD < -10 THEN "order_early"
      ELSE "on_time"
    END AS order_type
  FROM base
  WHERE EPT IS NOT NULL AND PDT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  "TOTAL" AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  COUNTIF(pdt_gt_ept) AS pdt_gt_ept_orders,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(pdt_gt_ept), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS pct_pdt_gt_ept,
  NULL AS order_type,
  NULL AS share_within_pdt_gt_ept
FROM flagged
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "BY_ORDER_TYPE (within PDT>EPT)" AS bucket,
  NULL AS total_orders,
  COUNT(*) AS pdt_gt_ept_orders,
  NULL AS pct_pdt_gt_ept,
  order_type,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS share_within_pdt_gt_ept

WHERE pdt_gt_ept
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY bucket, share_within_pdt_gt_ept DESC

    WHEN o.region = "Americas" THEN "Pedidosya"

    COUNTIF(d.stacked_deliveries > 0 AND o.timings.rider_late/60 > 10 AND o.timings.rider_late IS NOT NULL),
    COUNTIF(d.stacked_deliveries > 0 AND o.timings.rider_late IS NOT NULL)

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone))) AS report_week,
    CASE
      WHEN preptime_code_version_used_for_vendor = "null - OPS VALUE USED" THEN "fixed prep times"
      WHEN preptime_code_version_used_for_vendor IS NULL THEN "unknown"
      ELSE "model"
    END AS ept_type,
    o.order_id,
    o.estimated_prep_time/60 AS EPT,
    o.timings.at_vendor_time_cleaned/60 AS AAPT
  FROM `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl.orders` o
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(deliveries) d ON is_primary
  LEFT JOIN `fulfillment-dwh-production.cl._ds_map_orders_to_preptime_code_versions` ds
    ON o.country_code = ds.country_code
    AND o.created_date = ds.created_date
    AND o.platform_order_code = ds.global_order_id
  WHERE o.created_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 21 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
    AND COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone))
        BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 21 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND o.is_preorder IS FALSE
    AND o.order_status = "completed"
    AND o.country_code = "cl"
    AND FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", COALESCE(DATE(d.rider_dropped_off_at, o.timezone), DATE(d.created_at, o.timezone)))
        IN (
          FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)),
          FORMAT_DATE("%GW%V", DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
        )
)

  report_week,
  ept_type,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY report_week), 2) AS pct_of_week_orders,
  ROUND(AVG(EPT), 2) AS avg_EPT,
  ROUND(AVG(AAPT), 2) AS avg_AAPT
FROM base
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, orders DESC
